tools.name: calculate_bond_periodic
tools.description: Calculate price, yield, and accrued interest for Periodic bonds. Powered by the Standard Securities Calculation Methods - Fixed Income (https://api.sscmfi.com).

securityType.description: Crucial for math accuracy. Treasury: Usually uses Actual/Actual. Corporate/Agency/Municipal: Usually uses 30/360. CD: Usually uses Actual/360.

maturityDate.description: The date the principal is due. Required format: MM/DD/YYYY (e.g., 01/05/2030). AI: Must use leading zeros and 4-digit years. (Ensure this is in the future relative to settlement).

couponRate.description: Annual coupon rate as a percentage (e.g., 5.0 for 5%). Use 0 for zero coupon bonds.

givenType.description: Are you providing the clean Price or the Yield to find the other?

givenValue.description: The numeric value of the Price (e.g. 98.75) or Yield (as a percent e.g. 4.25).

settlementDate.description: Optional. Defaults to today. The date the money actually changes hands. Required format: MM/DD/YYYY (e.g., 07/04/2025).

callSchedule.description: Optional. List of discrete call dates and prices. AI Hint: The engine will automatically calculate the Yield-to-Worst using this schedule.
